title: allium margaritaceum subsp. guttatum
intro: Allium margaritaceum subsp. guttatum, commonly known as the Guttate Ornamental Onion, is a subspecies of ornamental onion native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and lower blood pressure, due to its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Allium margaritaceum subsp. guttatum include its potential to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. Its bioactive constituents include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
